votes.title: Budget Vote
votes.plain_summary: The BVSD Board of Education approved the Fiscal Year 2024 budget, with six board members voting in favor and one against.
votes.rationale_summary: Voted in favor of approving the Fiscal Year 2024 budget.

votes.title: Budget Vote on Public Transportation
votes.plain_summary: The board approved a budget increase for public transportation to improve service and reliability.
votes.rationale_summary: Improving public transportation will benefit many residents and encourage more people to use it.
votes.verbatim_quote: We should invest in our public transportation system for better service and accessibility.

votes.title: Motion for Employee Benefits Review

votes.rationale_summary: We need more time to gather data and consider various options before making a decision.
votes.verbatim_quote: Let's take some time to review this motion.
